policy: Owner-approved read-only reference: small fixture windows open briefly on the owner's desktop; every input is a message to the fixture's own windows; no input injection, no setting changes; dialogs pass OFN_DONTADDTORECENT

comdlg32_restore.method: reg export snapshot before the run; afterwards only values absent from the snapshot are deleted (and subkeys the run created), and changed or missing values are re-imported byte-for-byte from the snapshot's own data; the key itself is never deleted

registry.note: OFN_DONTADDTORECENT keeps RecentDocs unchanged; the Explorer-style dialog still updates its ComDlg32 MRU lists during the run; the run's changes to the key are undone value by value afterwards
